A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same diagram-understanding study. Their text, tables, figures and appendices support reliable comparison after matching reordered sections and resized displays.

before.justification: v2 reports original LVLM evaluations on synthetic and real diagrams, including accuracy tables, controlled knowledge comparisons, robustness tests and case studies.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and reports additional model results in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: The test-suite construction, entity/relation question families and semantic-knowledge grounding procedure are retained. Additional evaluated models do not introduce a new proposed algorithm or inference procedure.

E1.justification: Both use the same synthetic-diagram coverage and 1,001 FoodWeb/AI2D real diagrams across six domains. Section 2.3, Table 8 and the appendix annotations retain the same tasks and test scenarios.

E2.justification: Tables 2–7, 9 and 11 expand the comparison panel with Molmo, Qwen2-2B and Qwen2-72B, adding another model family and smaller/larger Qwen alternatives throughout the principal comparisons. The original six models remain; the former Qwen2 row matches Qwen2-7B.

E3.justification: The added 2B and 72B Qwen configurations expand the evaluated model-size range. Diagram generation, question construction, accuracy metrics, zero-shot/CoT prompting, four-shot controls and the documented API settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The existing semantic-grounding and knowledge-required/free comparisons gain evidence for three additional models in Tables 5–7. The questions investigated are retained, as are the diagram-style, ICL, complexity and relation-removal/randomization analyses.

E5.justification: Both disclose a seed for GPT-4V and GPT-4o without providing repeated-run counts, confidence intervals or significance tests. Expanded cross-model averages do not introduce a new uncertainty-reporting practice.

E6.justification: Tables 2–7, 9 and 11 add substantial results for the three additional models and revise aggregate averages. Table 7's average recognition/counting gains change from 9.5/1.2 to 8.7/2.5 percentage points across different model panels. Retained models' underlying scores remain unchanged, but Table 6 incorrectly changes Gemini's counting delta from downward to upward despite retaining 75.5 and 68.4.

T1.justification: Section 2 retains the diagram-as-graph and question-set definitions, along with Intuition 1. Neither version supplies theoretical proofs, and no substantive mathematical reasoning is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction findings and conclusion retain the same claims about stronger entity understanding, weaker relational understanding and reliance on knowledge shortcuts. The enlarged model panel supports the existing contribution rather than redefining it.

C2.justification: The knowledge-shortcut explanations, complexity interpretation and hallucination case study are retained. Identical limitations move from v2 Appendix B to v3 Appendix A. The new Impact Statement offers broad implications without adding a substantive mechanism or applicability boundary.

D1.justification: v3 adds a direct public-code link in footnote 1 alongside the retained dataset link. v2 already described code, data and model responses in supplementary files; that reproducibility paragraph and the existing configuration details are retained.

R1.justification: New Section 6 and rewritten Appendix B sharpen the discussion of natural-image benchmarks and the synthetic/real diagram gap. Several in-text citations disappear, including Antol et al. (2015) and Zhang et al. (2016), although the bibliography is unchanged. The central research positioning remains similar.

P1.justification: v3 adds a main-text related-work summary, Impact Statement and acknowledgments, rewrites part of the appendix related work, and reorganizes the early appendices. These are localized changes; the main scientific narrative and most appendix prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Result tables gain rows or columns and reorder models. Figures are resized or repositioned, notably the full-width Figure 2 and more compact ICL examples. A logo and revised running headers are added, while the existing figure and table inventory is retained.

improvement.justification: The broader model comparisons strengthen the empirical basis across model families and sizes, and the direct code link improves reproducibility information. These benefits are limited by incomplete integration: Section 4.2 retains old averages despite the revised Table 7, and Table 6 introduces an incorrect Gemini delta direction. The net gain is useful but modest.
